1.1: Tis true without lying, certain and most true.
1.2: That which is below is like that which is above and that which is above is like that which is below to do the miracles of one only thing.
1.3: And as all things have been and arose from one by the mediation of one: so all things have their birth from this one thing by adaptation.
1.4: The Sun is its father, the moon its mother, the wind hath carried it in its belly, the earth is its nurse.
1.5: The father of all perfection in the whole world is here.
1.6: Its force or power is entire if it be converted into earth.
1.7: Separate thou the earth from the fire, the subtle from the gross sweetly with great industry.
1.8: It ascends from the earth to the heaven and again it descends to the earth and receives the force of things superior and inferior.
1.9: By this means you shall have the glory of the whole world and thereby all obscurity shall fly from you.
1.10: Its force is above all force, for it vanquishes every subtle thing and penetrates every solid thing.
1.12: From this are and do come admirable adaptations whereof the means is here in this.
1.13: Hence I am called Hermes Trismegistus, having the three parts of the philosophy of the whole world.
1.14: That which I have said of the operation of the Sun is accomplished and ended.
